scope: Offline native C++20 procedural audio workstation with bounded file processing, WAV/JSON exchange, preset storage, local plugins and optional Qt desktop UI; not a hosted service or real-time audio-device host.

status_policy.rule: Use implemented or partial only when repository code and focused verification paths support the exact statement. Record limits explicitly. A design document, capability catalog or profile-validation job does not prove runtime behavior.

controls.title: Module boundaries and versioned contracts
controls.assessment: The native core, preset store and versioned interchange formats define local component boundaries with dedicated C++ tests.
limitations: The current interfaces do not establish a stable third-party plugin ABI or hosted service contract.

controls.title: Input validation and idempotent state changes
controls.assessment: WAV inspection and DSP compatibility tests cover selected file-boundary and buffer validation paths.
limitations: Offline file validation does not create a general request-idempotency protocol; file size and output policy remain format-specific.

controls.title: Low-level I/O and transport boundaries
controls.assessment: The application processes local WAV/MIDI and preset data through offline file adapters; no network playback or remote transport is part of the product.
limitations: The file-processing path is not a network streaming service or audio-device transport implementation.

controls.title: Concurrency, scheduling and backpressure
controls.assessment: RuntimeTransaction supports a bounded asynchronous commit API with a focused test; this does not establish a general scheduler or real-time DSP worker architecture.
limitations: The asynchronous transaction contract is not used as permission to block or allocate in a real-time DSP callback.

controls.title: Memory ownership and resource lifetime
controls.assessment: Buffer processing is covered by functional tests, but a complete process-wide memory budget, allocator policy and lifetime audit have not been established.
limitations: Do not infer a global memory ceiling or zero-allocation real-time guarantee from bounded format tests.

controls.title: Data integrity and transactions
controls.assessment: Preset storage and RuntimeTransaction cover versioned local state, bounded staged payloads and rollback with focused tests.
limitations: Transaction snapshots are local application state; no database or cloud durability is claimed.

controls.title: Failure handling, recovery and lifecycle
controls.assessment: The transaction API exposes guarded failures and rollback; audio error codes have dedicated compatibility tests.
limitations: Rollback applies to staged in-memory state, not the audio device, project filesystem or operating system.

controls.title: Security, privileges and secret handling
controls.assessment: Plugin metadata and local project boundaries are covered by the documented feature scope and plugin tests; remote trust and secret handling are not product features.
limitations: Manifest discovery does not authorize dynamic code loading; no privileged device or network control is claimed.

controls.title: Observability and diagnostics
controls.assessment: The DSP compatibility layer has typed audio error reporting and documented error cases with regression tests.
limitations: Typed error reporting is not end-to-end tracing or production latency telemetry.

controls.title: Performance budgets and capacity
controls.assessment: No repeatable end-to-end render-latency, memory-pressure or throughput baseline is recorded as a backend capacity contract.
limitations: Offline DSP benchmarks must be measured separately from service throughput and real-time device deadlines.

controls.title: Configuration, extensibility and integration
controls.assessment: Preset formats, the plugin manager and local host-side integrations provide controlled extension points with compatibility tests.
limitations: Plugin metadata and script integrations do not imply unrestricted native extension loading.

controls.title: Verification and delivery gate
controls.assessment: This PR adds a machine-readable backend engineering profile, safe-path/status validator, negative self-tests and a dedicated CI gate.
limitations: The gate validates profile integrity and evidence paths; it does not certify audio quality, real-time safety or production readiness.
